Messages.Author: Pablo Alonso
Messages.Body:
Imagine this situation:

- I've got two vampires in the active region: Lucian and Normal
- I bleed with Lucian using a Govern the Unaligned and Pulse of the Canaille
(bleeding for 3+2=5)
- The bleed is succesful.
- The bleeded methuselah plays an Archon Investigation.

Can I play a Mask of 1000 Faces with Normal?
What happened then?

Thank you,

Pablo Alonso, Prince of Palma de Mallorca.

Messages.Author: Rob Treasure
Messages.Body:
Pablo

I don't think Normal can take over the action with Mask because he does not
have Dom. New (or confirmed old) rules a while back state the Vamp taking
over the action must be able to legally perform it.

I think if i remember correctly the ruling came about because of Return to
Innocence. Imagine the same example you give but with RtI instead of Gov the
Un. Ouch.

Rob T

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 06 Aug 2000 02:57:08 GMT, "Pablo Alonso"
<palonso(quitaestoparacontestar)@mail.ono.es> wrote:

>Imagine this situation:
>
>- I've got two vampires in the active region: Lucian and Normal
>- I bleed with Lucian using a Govern the Unaligned and Pulse of the Canaille
>(bleeding for 3+2=5)
>- The bleed is succesful.
>- The bleeded methuselah plays an Archon Investigation.
>
>Can I play a Mask of 1000 Faces with Normal?

Nope. Normal couldn't have played the Govern, since he doesn't have
Dominate. Therefore he can't take over the action - so Lucian goes p
poof. If Normal had a Dominate card, this would be legal.

If it was just a Pulse, I believe Normal could actually have taken
over the action, since inherent bleed wouldn't carry over after a
Mask. Why you'd want to I don't know. But he could.

-- Derek
Jack-Booted Thug of Atlanta

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Pablo Alonso" <palonso(quitaestoparacontestar)@mail.ono.es> wrote:
> - I bleed with Lucian using a Govern the Unaligned and Pulse of the
Canaille
> (bleeding for 3+2=5)
> - The bleed is succesful.
> - The bleeded methuselah plays an Archon Investigation.
>
> Can I play a Mask of 1000 Faces with Normal?

No, for two reasons:

1) Archon Investigation resolves when played, resulting in a
burned Lucian and the end of the action. (Barring Sudden Reversal,
of course).

2) Normal cannot Mask an action that he cannot perform - so unless
he has a Dominate skill card on him, he cannot mask an action that
requires dominate.
